purpose: Implement the Ashen Thrones Gameplay Benchmark infrastructure from the ATGB-01 design, with S07 moved to held-out. Validate it with providers disabled. Do not run a live benchmark and do not change production gameplay.
executive_summary: Implementation outcome: fixtures for 37 turns, an isolated chat driver, a provider-disabled simulated mode, a provider-disabled host path, a human worksheet, and a result format. Original reproduction: not applicable; this pass repairs no gameplay failure. Related generalization: not applicable. Independent generalization: not evaluated. The held-out partition is stored and labeled previously exposed because those scenarios were already in the ATGB-01 review. Regression: 49 passed across playability, review-handoff, and validation-evidence tests; the full suite was not run. ATGB: no performance result. Provider-disabled validation captured 37 simulated turns and 4 host turns of S06. Both packages set gameplay_performance_claim to false. Known limitations: simulated mode does not call chat; host mode is not conversational competence; held-out turns are not unseen; no historical adapter and no dollar default. Remaining uncertainty: the live trial count and any future price ceiling are unset, and the PR-BL session orientation is still unreconciled with later PR-EG history. No gameplay improvement is claimed.

production: No production gameplay module changed. game/ does not import the benchmark. evaluate_playability is not called.
validation: Added tests/test_atgb_infrastructure.py. Playability scenarios, semantic calibration, and protected replay were not edited.
tooling: Added tools/run_atgb.py and tools/atgb/. The driver posts to the existing POST /api/chat boundary in a subprocess and refuses unsafe data directories before reset.
documentation: Added the ATGB-02 specification, execution note, and implementation report.
Pointed docs/validation_evidence_standard.md at the implemented corpus and forbade a performance claim from infrastructure, host-only, or unscored output.
Left the ATGB-01 catalog body in place and recorded that its index still lists S07 as development-visible.
Updated docs/NEXT_SESSION.md. Did not start another Product Realization campaign.
generated_artifacts: Provider-disabled simulated run of all 37 turns at artifacts/atgb/atgb_02_infrastructure/.
Provider-disabled host run of S06 at artifacts/atgb/atgb_02_host_probe/. Neither artifact is a gameplay benchmark result.

testing.focused: 9 passed in tests/test_atgb_infrastructure.py. Covers fixture counts, catalog lines, isolation rejection, order, simulated labels, unavailable telemetry, worksheets, reproducibility, budget refusal, and one provider-disabled host scenario.
testing.runtime_validation: No live-provider execution. Original reproduction, related generalization, and independent generalization were not evaluated because this pass repairs no gameplay failure. Host S06 is infrastructure evidence only.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: No model was called. Provider-disabled host mode set ASHEN_DISABLE_PROVIDER_CALLS, ASHEN_DISABLE_LIVE_INTERPRETATION, and ASHEN_DISABLE_EXPRESSION_GENERATION, and removed the API key from the worker environment.
testing.new_regressions: None observed in the focused or adjacent tests that were run.
testing.pre_existing_failures: Not reassessed. The full suite was not run. docs/product_realization_validation.md already had an uncommitted generalization paragraph; this pass does not claim that diff.

decisions_requiring_human_review: Accept or reject the ATGB-02 corpus and harness before any live baseline.
The live trial count is still the design default of one. This pass does not choose a dollar ceiling.
Held-out turns remain previously exposed. A later unexposed environment would be required before a strong generalization claim.
The NEXT_SESSION product orientation versus later PR-EG history remains a separate maintenance item. This package does not decide it.

campaign_specific: Simulated replies are a test double. They do not exercise POST /api/chat.

The host performance counter can report a provider call for the provider-disabled narration fallback. The harness preserves the count and does not treat it as a sent request when tokens are null and the reply is stamped provider-disabled.
The benchmark copy of world.json is the repository file plus the existing playthrough reset. It does not rebuild a pristine world from git.
No historical compatibility adapter is implemented.
pre_existing: Playability scoring, semantic calibration, protected replay, and replay failure classification keep their existing authorities.
Curfew hours, stew price, diegetic time passage, compound multi-action execution, and richer pronoun continuity remain outside current authored behavior.
docs/NEXT_SESSION.md product orientation remains the 2026-09-26 PR-BL closeout. Later PR-EG history remains unreconciled.

missing_concepts: A live-provider baseline and a completed human score sheet for that transcript.
A provider price table. Cost stays unavailable until a run supplies prices and the host records token counts.
An unexposed held-out environment. The current held-out turns were visible in the ATGB-01 review.
A historical-build adapter. Older revisions are not comparable unless they can boot the same isolated store.
does_not_prove: An Ashen Thrones Gameplay Benchmark performance result.
That the scenarios would pass on the current build under a live model.
Independent generalization from the held-out partition.
Mechanical correctness of combat, inventory, economy, character creation, equipment, or advancement.
That playability PASS and ATGB acceptability are the same judgment.
That deterministic host behavior is natural conversational competence.
That the PR-BL session orientation and later PR-EG history agree.
recommended_next_step: Stop. Review this infrastructure before any live ATGB baseline. Do not report a gameplay-performance result from the provider-disabled runs. Do not modify production gameplay to improve benchmark results, and do not start another Product Realization campaign from this package.
